about_the_game:
From the creators of Kardiya: The Winds of Fate comes Livber: Smoke and Mirrors, a short interactive psychological horror story.

BRIEF SUMMARY

Years after assuming your former lover Lilith dead, you are summoned back to your old home, the silent witness of your past. The summons comes in the form of a single letter, bearing only an address and a couple of eerie lines: "I will give birth to our child in our home. Come, and complete us in the dark. We were always meant to be one."

After five years of silence, you return, haunted by questions that demand answers. But what awaits you is not Lilith’s grave... it is her living shadow. Lilith is alive.

As your talk spirals into madness, you are dragged into a labyrinth, shaped by your own sins and fears. Your desperate flight through the house becomes a descent not just into Lilith’s obsessions, but into the grave of your own suppressed guilt. You are not alone in the dark: lost souls imprisoned in Lilith’s dungeons claw their way toward you, each a mirror of the man she tried to bury. Each step, each room, each breath whispers the same question: "When you lose the one you love, who do you become?"

Running from Lilith, running from yourself, your path spirals back to where it all began, the dinner table, the broken silence. But this time, the choices are not made with words; they are made with actions. Stay or leave. Forgive or condemn. Every move, every silence, shapes the story’s end.

Livber: Smoke and Mirrors is a dark psychological thriller about how love rots, how longing festers into obsession, and how sometimes, to love is to destroy.

CREDITS

  • A wonderful interactive story by Oğuzhan Açıkalın

  • Emotionally inducing music by Uluç Kaymak

  • Translated from Turkish with care and craft by Muh. Semih Çavuş

FEATURES

  • Cat with wings? Exactly. Cat with wings!

  • How much branching would you like? - YES!

  • A tightly woven narrative that splinters with each choice you make.

  • Psychological horror without JUMP SCARE!

  • Set in the haunting, breathing world of Gaia: beautiful, cruel, and alive.

  • Multiple endings shaped by your descent, your silence, your screams.

  • A story that does not simply ask what kind of person you are. It dares you to answer.

short_description: A short psychological horror interactive story. Five years after vanishing without a trace, the woman you once called your lover writes from beyond the silence: "I will give birth to your child.” In three acts, descend into a fractured mindscape where obsession, memory, and myth intertwine.
